  ];
  const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t, smooth=t=>t*t*(3-2*t);
  function mixHex(a,b,t){
    const pa=[parseInt(a.slice(1,3),16),parseInt(a.slice(3,5),16),parseInt(a.slice(5,7),16)];
    const pb=[parseInt(b.slice(1,3),16),parseInt(b.slice(3,5),16),parseInt(b.slice(5,7),16)];

    return '#'+c;
  }

    const pieces=[

      `<span class="identify-line">That ${icon('yellow')} digital product.</span>`,

  }

  }
  function renderBase24(p){
    p=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,p)); const s=p*(frameData.length-1); const i=Math.min(frameData.length-2,Math.floor(s)); const t=smooth(s-i), a=frameData[i], b=frameData[i+1];

    setIdentifyCopy(Math.round(lerp(a.copy,b.copy,t)));

  }

  function setCharState(frame){
    characterScene.style.opacity='1';
    bg.style.background='#ff6d41'; hero.style.opacity='0'; rail.style.opacity='0'; identify.style.opacity='0'; ribbons.style.opacity='0'; transform.style.opacity='0';

    else if(frame<=30){show('028'); if(frame>=29) characterCopy.style.opacity='1'; if(frame===30){characterTitle.style.opacity='1'; characterTitle.textContent='Meet Bartss'; characterSub.style.opacity='0'; characterCopy.style.opacity='0';}}

    else {show('039'); characterPurple.style.opacity='1'; slash1.style.opacity='1'; slash2.style.opacity='1';}
  }
  function renderAll(frameFloat){
    const f=Math.max(1,Math.min(39,frameFloat));
    if(f<=24){ characterScene.style.opacity='0'; renderBase24((f-1)/23); return; }
    const fr=Math.round(f); setCharState(fr);
  }
  const params=new URLSearchParams(location.search), frame=params.get('frame');
